canonical_default.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define guide-bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 7)))
             (define gr0 (first guide-bb))
             (define gc0 (second guide-bb))
             (define gr1 (third guide-bb))
             (define gc1 (fourth guide-bb))
             (define glyphs
               (filter (lambda (obj)
                         (and (!= (obj-color obj) 5) (!= (obj-color obj) 7)))
                       (objects g 5)))
             (define selected
               (find-first (lambda (obj)
                             (let ((ctr (obj-center obj)))
                               (and
                                 (>= (first ctr) gr0)
                                 (<= (first ctr) gr1)
                                 (>= (second ctr) gc0)
                                 (<= (second ctr) gc1))))
                           glyphs))
             (crop-object g selected)))))

input_constraints: Each retained input is a lawful production teaching board with at least two eligible components whose raw crops differ.
invariant_reasoning: form the inclusive bbox of all 7 guide cells
enumerate non-5/7 same-color 4-connected components in row-major order
keep components whose floored bbox center lies inside the guide bbox
choose according to the episode-level order and return its raw bbox crop
limitations: Evidence covers one deterministic four-pair episode per setting, not every seed or every plausible selection policy.
The alternate last-eligible rule is proposed only; it is not a canonical rule change or training approval.
Inputs deliberately use the existing compound teaching construction; ordinary one-eligible boards cannot reveal this parameter.

selection_order.meaning: Choose the first or last row-major 4-connected component whose floored bbox center lies inside the all-7 guide bbox.

scope: Proposed task-local parametric extension only; canonical authority, production generation, and approval state are unchanged.
